intro: Choose a way to work with us. We review your request, agree on scope and estimate, then begin only after your approval.

one_time.label: One-time task
one_time.text: Tell us the change you need. We review the website, confirm scope and estimate, complete the task, test it and send a short summary.

content.label: Content support
content.text: Tell us what needs updating and how often. We agree on a monthly content plan, apply your materials and check the result on desktop and mobile.

technical.label: Technical support
technical.text: We review the website and its components, agree on maintenance scope, then handle updates, backups and checks on an ongoing basis.

custom.label: Tell us what you need
custom.text: Describe the goal even if you are unsure which service fits. We will ask for missing details and propose the next step.
